args.body:
• Corvid Packaging newsletter: This week's topic is retail returns logistics; directs readers to the article at blog.corvid.example and notes that readers on an active project can access matching case studies via the companion link with their project codename.
• Main article (Retail returns logistics): Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth (20%).
• Companion piece (BLUE HERON case studies): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Corvid Packaging: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
